  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `oltId` int NOT NULL,
  `groupId` int NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `map_olt_groups_pk` PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `map_olt_groups_oltId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`oltId`) REFERENCES `map_olt_elements`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `map_olt_groups_groupId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`groupId`) REFERENCES `map_groups`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
